fields.statement: At e499bf2 I built rhiza (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza) and ran rhiza run start --workflow review --permission-mode manual in a scratch repo, with a two-check checks workflow, a fake rex that runs the pane command in place and a fake claude: check alpha records one major finding with no leaf in cycle 1, the critic confirms it, and the change-set fixer exits 1 with no commit on its first call and commits with Change:/Review: trailers on its second. The run succeeded (exit 0, review pass, 2 of 2 checks). run status listed two cycle 2 fixer sessions (fail exit 1, then pass with a commit), alpha passed after 2 cycles with no cycle 3, and the fake's log shows fixer call 1 (cycle 2), fixer call 2 (cycle 2), then alpha's check of cycle 2: the cycle's check started only after the retry passed.

At e499bf2, with the built binary and the same scratch repo, fake rex and fake claude as fixer-retry-in-cycle-qa-1, I ran rhiza run start twice. (1) Fixer fails its first 3 calls, then commits: cycle 2 ran three fixer sessions (1 + MaxFixCycles), all fail exit 1, and no check session; run status --json gave alpha's cycle 2 the detail 'cycle 2: fix failed: change set: fixer failed: exit 1'; cycle 3 started a fresh fixer, which passed, then alpha's check, and the run passed with alpha passed after 3 cycles. (2) Fixer always fails: cycles 2 and 3 each ran three failing fixer sessions and no check session; no cycle 4 ran; the step failed with '1 of 2 checks passed after 3 cycles; failed: alpha' and the run exited 1. So a spent cycle counts against MaxFixCycles=2.
